svg.title: spaCR
svg.desc: NVIDIA (CUDA): Cellpose 4 GPU, Torch GPU, UMAP / clustering GPU, 3D GPU. AMD on Linux (ROCm): Cellpose 4 GPU, Torch GPU, UMAP / clustering CPU, 3D GPU. AMD in an Intel Mac (Metal): Cellpose 4 GPU, Torch GPU, UMAP / clustering CPU, 3D GPU. Apple Silicon (Metal): Cellpose 4 GPU, Torch GPU, UMAP / clustering CPU, 3D GPU. Intel Arc/Xe (XPU): Cellpose 4 GPU, Torch GPU, UMAP / clustering CPU, 3D GPU. No GPU: Cellpose 4 CPU, Torch CPU, UMAP / clustering CPU, 3D CPU. समर्थित (स्थिर) लागू (बीटा) केवल CPU समर्थन.
